r33_optimizer_mechanism.name: curvature_matched_native_scored_motion_optimizer
r33_optimizer_mechanism.metric: For S and N, compute soft-model native-anchored residual GN direct control curvature c_uu before Riccati. g[t,a]=max(c_uu[t,a,a],0). gbar=mean over nonterminal nodes/actions. D[t,a]=gbar*max(g[t,a]/gbar,1e-6), equivalently max(g[t,a],1e-6*gbar); no unit-mean replacement of the Hessian scale. D is objective/rad^2, mu is dimensionless. Terminal repeats last D.
r33_optimizer_mechanism.zero_curvature: If gbar=0, characteristic=sum(nonnegative original cost weights)/(horizon*sum(original actuator target span^2)); floor=1e-6*characteristic. No absolute floor 1. If entire objective has no positive curvature scale, explicit error.
r33_optimizer_mechanism.regularization: H=Q_uu+mu*diag(D); Q_ux is unchanged. mu starts 1, rate1 each actual new r32 epoch. Existing min/max 1e-6/1e6 now dimensionless multiples of D; native .5/.1 ratio rules and factors unchanged. All r30 constrained k,K,active sets,Vx,Vxx,dV and deployed H recomputed.
r33_optimizer_mechanism.N: First compute exactly the S soft D in the same nominal snapshot, freeze it, then recompute dynamics finite differences with an unsmoothed native-contact model copy. Residual derivatives and value recursion are recomputed for native direction. No N-based metric adaptation.
r33_optimizer_mechanism.P: No S or N solve before P. One 32-slot batch: two cached nominal-stage baseline identities (incumbent and best nominal), plus 15 signed pairs. Base is exact best scored nominal complete policy, all reference/K/H/scaling unchanged; only action target time structure changes. 5 groups (FL,FR,RL,RR,FL+RR) x onsets 0/.08/.16s; duration .16s; within z in (0,1): hip +=sign*.04 sin(2pi z), thigh +=sign*.04 sin(pi z), calf -=sign*.08 sin(pi z), radians. Native rollout and installation share same policy object.
r33_optimizer_mechanism.acceptance: Every method including reconstructed R32 shares exact scored complete-policy archive contract. Finite (trunk violation,J) ordering retained, no threshold relaxation, no surrogate acceptance. All scored nominal and alpha/P candidates retained; same score ties keep first incumbent-compatible ordering. No valid candidate returns FAILED_PRECONDITION.
r33_optimizer_mechanism.budget: S/N/R32 at most 5 total regularization attempts and 10 alpha rollouts per successful backward. One successful nominal improvement per call. Nominal feedback screening 10 is separate. N performs two derivative passes (soft metric plus native direction); FD subcalls reported separately. P has 32 slots, 2 cached baseline identities, 30 native new proposal rollouts, in addition to nominal screen. P32 is not equal compute budget or worker count.
r33_optimizer_mechanism.context: Saved four problems loaded through one binary exact policy import and shared state/time/userdata/task reconstruction. Historical private task context remains explicitly unavailable; reconstructed R32 provides the causal baseline.
r33_optimizer_mechanism.recording: r32 full Riccati/search fields retained. Separate r33-scale file stores mean/floor/D. Per-call r33-candidates transport records every scored candidate full native states/actions/times/residual, exact reference/K/H/Q/active/scaling and actual native-foot rows; Python retains bounded event windows. Native feet per-node stride29 includes time plus four (xyz,bottom_z,nativeFz,materialFz,count). Task parameters/weights/gait private reconstruction, native computation counts, source identity, chosen-alpha unclipped actual/expected recorded.
r33_optimizer_mechanism.startup_acceptance: Every alpha candidate must strictly improve the current best nominal in the original native (trunk violation,J) ordering before eligibility for deployment archive, including initial startup with no valid metric. All alpha candidates remain recorded. No descent and no valid scored baseline produces explicit no-deployable failure; building a metric alone is not acceptance.
r33_optimizer_mechanism.online: Only N: compute shared soft-GN D then native-contact FD, full constrained Riccati and native acceptance. No P proposals online.

r34_policy_acceptance.name: complete_policy_resolved_descent_and_tie_retention
r34_policy_acceptance.cost_accumulation: FP64 sequential weighted norm terms per node, sequential sum over T nodes, divide by T; original risk=0.
r34_policy_acceptance.cost_budget: u=epsilon64/2; n=T*(8*num_residual+4*num_terms+2)+1; gamma=n*u/(1-n*u). B=gamma*(mean(sum(abs(weighted_terms))) + 2*sum(abs(weight*p)*(norm6?dimension:1)) for smooth norms2/6). tau=B(candidate)+B(baseline). No universal absolute1e-6; cancellation envelope provides scale-dependent absolute part.
r34_policy_acceptance.roundoff_scope: Conservative all-operations envelope including squares, smooth sqrt/subtraction, weights and sums, with sqrt rounded to FP64. Does not bound contact/dynamics divergence; same-input native repeat measured in four-problem evidence.
r34_policy_acceptance.ordering: Exact original trunk(v) comparison; only equal-v cost descent must exceed tau. No change to physical admissibility.
r34_policy_acceptance.alpha0: Always no-step in action search; record full scored candidate but retain scored complete baseline. Pure feedback replacement is not enabled by nominal score.
r34_policy_acceptance.baseline: Current epoch native score. Incumbent-first identical traversal in BestRollout/archive; complete actions/times/reference/K/H/scaling retained on ties.
r34_policy_acceptance.lifecycle: Shared comparator in nominal/archive/descent; reject zero alpha in archive and Iteration. Existing at most5 attempts, stop and epoch reset preserved. No fake1e-16 expected; unresolved expected or projected ratio leaves both lambda/rate unchanged.
r34_policy_acceptance.positive_alpha: Unchanged complete native scoring and TV/H projection; resolved descent remains eligible. No K cap.
r34_policy_acceptance.offline: Same executable legacy acceptance path only for four saved-problem comparisons; online strict by default. Saved gait context restored only under explicit offline file. SCORE_ONLY is offline native full-policy confirmation, no derivatives.
r34_policy_acceptance.recording: Candidate binary schema33 and plan schema32 retained; r34 high-precision decision list in planner-calls, with baseline source, slot, alpha, scales, tolerance and reason. Full objects saved through existing event ring.
